svg.aria-label: Why children breathe more pollution: children breathe about twice as much air per kilogram of body weight, their faces sit at vehicle-exhaust height, and their lungs and brains are still developing, so in the same street a child inhales a bigger, more damaging dose.
svg.text: same street, same air — a bigger, more damaging dose
more of the same air, per kilo of body weight
closest to tail-pipe and road-level fumes
to about age 18 — damage can last a lifetime
